sections.text:
[Effects]
Reflects physical and magic damage taken by XL.
Nullifies Blind.
Nullifies Slumber.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.
When an Ability that causes Blind or Slumber is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Wind enemies increases to L.
Activation rate scales with the number of Fire elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
